run_main_training_loop: run the main training loop for supervision by registration model with CLI arguments
run_obtain_basic_args: run the argument parser to obtain basic training configuration arguments from command line
run_obtain_model: run obtain_model to create a neural network from model config and number of points
run_obtain_optimizer: run obtain_optimizer to create optimizer, scheduler, and criterion from network parameters and config
run_load_configure: run load_configure to load and parse a model or optimizer configuration file
